project.objective: Confirm the children of Santiago Gonzalez and his wife Petra Tumbaco of Guayaquil, Guayas, Ecuador

questions.question: Is the mother named in the burial record of Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco — 'Petita Tumbaco' — the same person as the subject's wife Petra Tumbaco (I2)?
questions.rationale: A cemetery record for a possible additional child names the mother as 'Petita Tumbaco'; its identity to the established wife Petra Tumbaco must be evaluated before the record is used to add a child.

items.rationale: An Ecuadorian cemetery record surfaced for a Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco naming Santiago Gonzalez and 'Petita Tumbaco' as parents.

log.notes: Cemetery record for Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco (b. 1915, d. 5 Dec 1985, Guayaquil). Parents named: father Santiago Gonzalez, mother 'Petita Tumbaco'. Father's name matches the subject exactly; the mother's GIVEN name 'Petita' differs from the tree's 'Petra'.

sources.citation: "Ecuador, registros de cementerios, 1862-2020", FamilySearch, entry for Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco and Santiago Gonzalez, 5 Dec 1985; digital image, accessed 2 May 2026.
sources.notes: Parents reported at death registration ~70 years after the subject's birth; informant not recorded. The mother's given name is recorded as 'Petita', not 'Petra'.

assertions.informant_bias_notes: Mother's name reported at the son's death registration in 1985, decades after any relevant event; informant unknown.
